coverage.notes: TRAPPIST-1 i found, but only in a telescope proposal: JWST DDT proposal 12492 (PI Agol, created 3 Dec 2025), 'Confirming an 8th planet in the TRAPPIST-1 system'. It claims an 8th planet from TTVs, P = 28.7 d (favoured of three TTV solutions, near 3:2 with h), mass within a factor of 2 of Mars, and a transit attempt on 11-12 Dec 2025. No refereed paper or arXiv preprint naming 'TRAPPIST-1 i' was found: arXiv all:"TRAPPIST-1 i" returned 0 hits; abs:TRAPPIST-1 with eighth / additional planet / planet candidate / outer planet / transit timing (to Sep 2026) turned up nothing naming i; Agol+2021 (arXiv:2010.01074) explicitly could not explain timing outliers with an eighth planet; L'Heureux+2026 (SPIRou/NIRPS RV, arXiv:2609.03006) does not mention it and only rules out Saturn-mass planets to 2.7 yr. The outcome of the Dec 2025 JWST transit attempt was not found published. exoplanet.eu search page could not be read (JS); a fan-wiki page 'TRAPPIST-1 i' exists but is fiction/unsourced and was not used. NASA and the sheet list b-h only.
